method: Read-only CFR 0.152 class analysis; original installer/app/license never executed.

observations.observed: Reads items or result.items; native product id comes from id then product_id; barcode values come from barcodes array, offer_id remains separate; SKU comes from sku then fbo_sku.
observations.inference: Product barcode data and the numeric native SKU are separate identities. This parser does not read a dedicated GTIN JSON field or the order tracking barcode.
observations.verification: Trace downstream mapping normalization and active Catalog lookup before treating a barcode as an accepted GTIN.

observations.source: OzonProductDto canonical constructor and withCardAttributes overloads
observations.observed: Stores productId, offerId, SKU, name, article, color, size, manufacturerSize and barcodes separately. Barcode list is sanitized, distinct and capped at100. Card attributes can enrich model/color/size/brand/TN VED/composition without changing stored native identity/barcodes.
observations.inference: A display title is not the native association key. This data model alone does not establish a match policy.
observations.verification: Follow OzonZnackMappingService and OzonGtinMappingSyncService for the actual candidate predicates.

observations.observed: Lists v3/product/list, reads v3/product/info/list by product_id or sku/offer_id, and v4/product/info/attributes. Client validates product page/count arguments up to1000.
observations.inference: These are bounds observed in this application, not independently revalidated current official API limits.
observations.verification: Call-site cursor/total logic and official Ozon contract require separate review. No seller API was called for this finding.

observations.observed: Accepts1..100 bindings; writes numeric sku and normalized barcode to v1/barcode/add.
observations.inference: Barcode dispatch targets native SKU. HTTP success and this helper alone do not prove server-side publication/readback.
observations.verification: Review response errors and downstream readback paths separately.

observations.observed: Normalizer trims, requires digit-only1..14characters and left-pads to14. Check-digit validation is a separate method. Technical range helper checks normalized029 prefix. No046-only test in this class.
observations.inference: A numeric native SKU is not automatically a GTIN just because the helper can normalize numeric strings. Check the caller's Catalog/identity rules. Do not claim every normalization call performs checksum validation.
observations.verification: Inspect actual GTIN extraction/candidate call sites; optionally corroborate specific methods with javap.
